Tail = 0.75*IREF = 7.5 uA gives SR = 3.75 V/us and 31.5 uW. A weak-inversion pair (gm/Id ~20) gives gm ~75 uS, so GBW ~5.5 MHz. Long-L pair (2 um) and mirror (1 um) give A0 ~44-45 dB. PARAMS = {
```python
    "gmid1": (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),   # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion, efficiency)
    "L1":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),      # input pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "gmid3": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),     # PMOS mirror gm/Id (low -> less noise, more gds margin)
    "L3":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # PMOS mirror L
    "ratio": (0.75, 0.5, 0.82),    # Itail / IREF (power budget!)
    "gmidt": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),    # tail / reference gm/Id
    "Lt":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),      # tail / reference L (CMRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail = p["ratio"] * iref
    i1 = itail / 2.0

    # reference diode and tail current source (same gm/Id and L -> ratio by W)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], itail, vds=0.35)

    # input pair: iterate on tail-node voltage (body effect, bulk = vss)
    vtail = 0.3
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=vtail)
        vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.1)
    vd1 = vdd - 0.75  # approximate mirror-diode node
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vd1 - vtail, 0.2), vsb=vtail)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=0.75)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], i1, vds=vdd - vcm)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinp drives the diode side -> vout is non-inverting w.r.t. vinp
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---------------- predictions ----------------
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m4.cdd + m4.cgd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))
    cmrr = a0 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12)
    psrr = a0 * 1.2  # mirror-load 5T: supply injection ~ cancelled, ~A0
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    vn_th = math.sqrt(4 * kT * (2.0 / 3.0) * 2 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    vn_1k = vn_th * 6.0  # flicker-dominated estimate at 1 kHz
    slew = itail / cout
    power = vdd * (iref + itail)
    swing = (vdd - m4.vdsat - 0.05) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0),
        "ugbw": ugbw,
        "pm": pm,
        "noise_1k": vn_1k,
        "cmrr_db": db(cmrr),
        "psrr_db": db(psrr),
        "slew": slew,
        "power": power,
        "swing": swing,
        "settle": settle,
    }
```
